nodes.title: The Lament of the Women
nodes.historical_context: The battlefield is silent, filled only with the cries of the grieving women. Dhritarashtra is crushed by the loss of his 100 sons.

nodes.title: Gandhari's Curse
nodes.historical_context: Gandhari blames Krishna for the war. In a moment of immense agony backed by her tapasyā, she curses him and his clan to doom.
